column1: # mesh-dualboot 8 MB partition table for ESP32-S3 — NET-OTA variant.
# T-Beam Supreme (8 MB flash) layout for selectors built with MDB_NET_OTA.
# The 8 MB chip has only 64 KB tail slack today; growing factory means
# Apps are 64 KB-aligned; data partitions 4 KB-aligned.
# Slot assignment (firmware-to-slot mapping is in slots.json):
#   factory  -> selector app (boot menu + net-OTA listener)
